name: Åland

flag.description: A blue field with a yellow Nordic cross, inside which runs a narrower red Nordic cross.
flag.symbolism: Blue and yellow come from the flag of Sweden, reflecting the islands' Swedish language and culture, while red and yellow are the colours of Finland's coat of arms.

hook: Åland is Sweden's flag with a red cross threaded through the middle of the yellow one: Swedish colours, Finnish red.
trivia: Åland is demilitarised and, under a 1921 League of Nations decision, belongs to Finland while keeping wide self-government and Swedish as its only official language.
It issues its own postage stamps and has its own internet domain, .ax.
